unit_evidence: AadlSymbols.scala getFramePeriod and getComputeExecutionTime convert to milliseconds. Scheduler compares these values to the default allocations.
meaning: Scheduling allocation, not AI tokens or measured worst-case execution time. Existing schedule and current generator defaults differ. The failure does not establish requirements infeasibility.
causal_limits: Saved XML alone does not establish why defaults differ or prove safe execution. The current generator capacity check occurs before schedule emission; simply copying XML has not been demonstrated to fix generation.
reference_boundary: Human compatibility audit only; saved example schedule remains evaluator material, not added to training or generator context.
next_step: Inspect example tool/version and schedule-generation policy; establish supported compatibility resolution without weakening timing or modifying reused tools.
